description: The assurance policy matrix (D12, wire contract section 8). Apps name a protected action by its key; the level, credential kind, session window and administrator requirement come from here, never from the app. Language-neutral: ports read this file.

use-app.action: Use a low-friction app (dinner, fasting, help desk, calendar)

change-role.action: Change a member's parent or kid role

manage-own-credential.action: A member adds or removes their own credential (Home Base hostname only, D21; a member with no credentials uses an enrollment grant instead, SID-005)

manage-admin-credential.action: Administrator adds or removes an administrator credential

privileged-plan.action: Privileged Home Base plans (install, repair, adopt, update, uninstall, restore), config changes, publishing changes, rotating secrets
